verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only engagement reporting: link clicks, peak engagement times, and exporting campaign results to a BI tool. Nothing documents conversion, signup or revenue attribution to specific emails or automation flows. Exporting campaign results for external analysis is a user-side building block, not attribution, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
